$comment: Central component inventory and lock set. This file is the single source of truth for
every external component CloudBurrow builds on. Reproducible builds consume the
'verified' versions here; #31 maintains it and tests 'latest-candidate' sets in an
isolated lane. A mutable tag may be used for discovery, never as the release pin:
'digest' is what a reproducible artifact resolves.

mode.verified: The pinned set below. Used by all ordinary, release and offline builds.
mode.latestCandidate: Discovered by #31, tested in isolation, never used for release artifacts until promoted here.

kind.notes: Initial and only reference cluster provider.

kubernetesNodeImage.notes: kind v0.33.0 publishes v1.34.11, v1.35.8, v1.36.4, v1.37.0. Chosen above Knative's enforced minimum without being newest. Digest resolved and pinned by #26/#28.

constraints.kubernetesMaxVersionNote: Upstream states no maximum. Not assumed.

knativeNetKourier.notes: Networking layer. Must be upgraded together with knativeServing.

pubsubEmulator.distribution: gcloud component 'pubsub-emulator', or the official image below
pubsubEmulator.licenseNote: The Cloud CLI is Apache-2.0 'unless otherwise specified by an alternate license file'. The JAR's LICENSE/NOTICE belong to bundled dependencies; the emulator's own classes have no published source. Do not claim it is open source.
pubsubEmulator.redistributionPlan: Run the official image pinned by digest, or have the user run 'gcloud components install pubsub-emulator'. Do not vendor the binary.
limitations: Does not persist state; a topic was NotFound after restart even with --data-dir.
Signed-URL signatures are not verified; a bogus X-Goog-Signature returned HTTP 200.

go.notes: Minimum language version in go.mod. 1.26 and 1.27 are the supported releases.

sdks.$comment: Official SDKs, used only to prove compatibility. Pinned by go.sum.

googleapis.notes: No release tags upstream, so an explicit branch is tracked and its checked commit pinned. Commit pinned by #4.

unresolved: Digests for kindest/node, Knative release YAML and fake-gcs-server are null until #26/#28 resolve and verify them. A null digest means this entry is not yet reproducible.
Knative v1.23.0 + Kubernetes v1.36.4 is pinned but not yet verified end to end; #28 is the gate.
